answer: Autonomous agent economies mitigate Sybil attacks using stake-weighted graph consensus and cryptographic proof-of-burn. To gain network influence, each agent node must lock cryptographically bound collateral. An attacker attempting to deploy a virtual sparrow agent swarm across an ocean of fake identities within a compute grove must deposit non-refundable capital for each key pair. This mechanism scales the marginal cost of identity creation super-linearly, rendering mass spoofing economically unfeasible.
